entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-23
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • .NET 10 desktop app missing_runtime url redirect #121907
  • ConfigurationBinder ignores required members #121905
    Future
  • Replace task.Wait() with Await disposes HttpContext.Features of the current HttpRequest #121904
  • [API Proposal]: TryFind for List<T> (and related collections) #121903
  • Cose.Tests.TestKeyRing.CreateECDsa fails with "OSStatus error -50" #121902

Closed

  • Share System.IO.Pipelines.BufferSegments (make BufferSegmentStack static) across instances of Pipe #49259
  • [API Proposal]: Alloc-free hex conversion #73026
    9.0.0
  • [API Proposal]: System.Numerics.Tensors serialization #121886
  • Extend runtimeconfig.json to provide native library remapping functionality #45312

PullRequests

Created

  • fix: CreateSubdirectory failing for root directories #121906
    area-System.IO, community-contribution
  • [wasm] Bump chrome for testing - linux: 142.0.7444.175, windows: 143.0.7499.40 #121901
    arch-wasm, area-Infrastructure-mono

Merged

  • [RyuJit/WASM] Reach the NYI in `genFnProlog` #121863
    arch-wasm, area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Save/restore contexts for custom notifiers #121743
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, runtime-async
  • Fixing a typo in Vector.Create method's index parameter description #121898
    area-System.Runtime.Intrinsics, community-contribution

Updated

  • Add compression magic number detection to System.Formats.Tar with helpful error messages #119996
    linkable-framework, area-System.Formats.Tar
  • Automatically rewind base stream position when decompression finishes #121111
    area-System.IO.Compression
  • Reliability fixes for the Thread Pools #121887
    area-System.Threading
  • [release/10.0] Add support for `Visual Studio 2026` CMake generator for `gen-buildsys.cmd` #121889
    area-Infrastructure, community-contribution
  • Do not ignore ClassLoader::ResolveTokenToTypeDefThrowing return values #121864
    area-VM-coreclr
  • [RuntimeAsync] Enable runtime async in Libraries partition #119432
    area-VM-coreclr, linkable-framework, runtime-async
  • Revert "Revert "Move hosting tests to XUnit 3"" #121072
    area-Host
  • Haiku: Process/thread management functions #121883
    area-System.Diagnostics.Process, community-contribution, os-haiku
  • Add documentation about debugging WSL with VS #121897
    area-Infrastructure-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Cleanup most usages of Windows file mapping #121896
    area-PAL-coreclr, community-contribution
